HPINBAR.EnableHint: Globally enables or disables HP numbers, Temp HP overlays, and the AC shield badge on token health bars in this world.
HPINBAR.VisibleTo: [HP in Bar] Who Sees the HP Numbers
HPINBAR.VisibleToHint: Controls who can read the exact numeric HP values on a token's health bar. Anyone who has permission to see the bar still sees the graphical bar itself.
HPINBAR.VisibleToEveryone: Everyone who can see the bar
HPINBAR.FontSize: [HP in Bar] HP & AC Font Size
HPINBAR.FontSizeHint: Base font size for the HP text and AC shield badge (automatically scales with map resolution so it looks consistent on every map).
HPINBAR.TextColorHint: Fill color of the HP numbers and AC value.
HPINBAR.StrokeColorHint: Outline color around the HP and AC numbers for sharp readability against the bar background.
HPINBAR.StrokeWidthHint: Thickness of the text outline in pixels (0 disables the outline).
HPINBAR.AcVisibleTo: [HP in Bar] Who Sees the AC Shield
HPINBAR.AcVisibleToHint: Controls who can see the Armor Class (AC) shield badge on tokens.
HPINBAR.AcVisibleToCombat: Friendly & Player Characters always; Neutrals & Enemies in same Combat
HPINBAR.TempShield: [HP in Bar] Temp HP Shield Overlay
HPINBAR.TempShieldHint: Draws temporary hit points as a translucent blue shield across the full height of the health bar instead of only D&D 5e's thin stripe.
HPINBAR.TempText: [HP in Bar] Temp HP in the Numbers
HPINBAR.TempTextHint: Choose how temporary hit points are displayed inside the numeric HP text on the bar.
BETTERMEASURE.EnableHint: Keeps the distance measurement tool at a constant, readable screen size regardless of camera zoom level or map grid size.
BETTERMEASURE.SizeHint: Constant screen size of the measurement label, line, and waypoints (100% = default readable size, independent of zoom).
BETTERMEASURE.IncludeTokenRuler: [Better Measure] Apply to Token Drag Measurement
BETTERMEASURE.IncludeTokenRulerHint: Also keeps the distance label and path line at a constant screen size when dragging tokens.
EASYSEND.EnableHint: Allows players to easily send inventory items and currency to other player characters via the item context menu ('...'), drag-and-drop onto tokens, or the currency bar.
EASYSEND.PostChat: [Easy Send] Post Transfer Message in Chat
EASYSEND.PostChatHint: Posts a summary card in the chat log whenever a player sends an item or currency to another character.
EASYSEND.NoRecipients: No other player characters found to send to.
EASYSEND.NoCurrencyToSend: This character has no currency to send.
EASYSEND.NoOnlineRecipientOrGM: Transfer could not be completed because neither a GM nor the receiving player is currently online.
SIMPLELIGHT.EnableHint: Adds a Light Sources menu button to the left column of the Token HUD to quickly apply configurable D&D 5e light sources (Torch, Lantern, Candle, Light Spell, Darkness, etc.).
SIMPLELIGHT.AllowPlayers: [Simple Light] Allow Players to Use Light Picker
SIMPLELIGHT.AllowPlayersHint: When enabled, players can apply configured light sources to tokens and actors they own.
SIMPLELIGHT.ConfigMenuHint: Customize built-in lights, icons, durations, and light types, create custom presets, and control per-player visibility.
SIMPLELIGHT.Settings.VisibilityUserHint: Visibility inherits the player default until you change it. Reset an override to follow the default again.
SIMPLELIGHT.Settings.VisibilityDefaultHi: Choose which lights players see by default. Individual player tabs can override these choices.
SIMPLELIGHT.Settings.VisibilityGlobalHin: Lights hidden in the Lights tab remain hidden for everyone.
SIMPLELIGHT.Errors.TokensUnavailable: These tokens are no longer available or you do not own all of them.
SIMPLELIGHT.Errors.ActorsNoPermission: Each token needs an actor you own to apply a light effect.
SIMPLELIGHT.Errors.ApplyFailed: Could not update all token lighting. Check the targeted tokens before trying again.
SIMPLELIGHT.Errors.TypeNameRequired: Every light type needs a name.
SIMPLELIGHT.Errors.InvalidHexColor: {name}: enter a six-digit hex color or leave it blank.
SIMPLELIGHT.Errors.AnimationWholeNumbers: Animation speed and intensity must be whole numbers.
SIMPLELIGHT.Errors.DurationWholeSeconds: {name}: duration must resolve to whole seconds.
SIMPLELIGHT.Errors.GmOnlyMacro: Run this macro as a GM to change the world's light settings.
SIMPLELIGHT.Errors.InvalidEntryId: Each light or light type needs a non-empty ID without surrounding spaces.
SIMPLELIGHT.Errors.TypeInUse: Change the lights using this type before removing it.
EFFECTSMANAGER.EnableHint: Adds an Active Effects Manager button to the Token HUD to quickly enable or disable active effects on owned actors.
EFFECTSMANAGER.AllowPlayersHint: Allows players to open and manage active effects on tokens and actors they own.
EFFECTSMANAGER.NoPermission: You no longer have permission to update these effects.
EFFECTSMANAGER.UpdateError: Could not update all effects. Reopen Active Effects Manager to check their current state.
STATUSEFFECTS.Enable: [Status Effects] Expand Condition Names in Token HUD
STATUSEFFECTS.EnableHint: Displays condition and status names next to their icons inside the Token HUD conditions menu.
STATUSEFFECTS.ColumnsHint: Number of columns used for the expanded status effects grid in the Token HUD (2–5).
PAUSEBORDER.EnableHint: Adds a glowing border around the screen (and optionally replaces the D&D 5e pause emblem with a pause icon) whenever the game is paused.
PAUSEBORDER.ColorHint: Color of the screen glow border and pause icon while the game is paused (default: purple #a855f7).
PAUSEBORDER.ReplaceIconHint: Replaces the standard D&D 5e pause banner graphic with a glowing FontAwesome pause icon.
EASYFLIP.EnableHint: Allows flipping selected tokens horizontally with a smooth animation using the keybinding (default: F, configurable under Configure Controls).
SHOWRANGES.EnableHint: Enables the Show Ranges canvas overlay (5 / 10 / 30 / 60 ft rings attached directly to tokens without needing extra modules).
SHOWRANGES.ModeHint: Choose whether the Show Ranges macro asks for visibility or toggles directly in Private or Shared mode.
SHOWRANGES.DialogContent: Who should see the range rings on the selected token(s)?
SHOWRANGES.SelectTokenWarn: Please select at least one token first!
SHOWRANGES.DisabledWarn: Show Ranges is currently disabled in your PurplePhoenix FVTT Tools settings.
SHOWRANGES.SharedPermissionWarn: You can only share or clear Shared range rings on tokens you own; local Private rings were used instead.
SETTINGSUI.KeybindInfoHint: The shortcut key for flipping selected tokens (default: F) can be customized in Foundry's Configure Controls dialog.
SETTINGSUI.BadgeGMTooltip: World setting (GM only): Applies to all players in this world.
SETTINGSUI.BadgeClientTooltip: Client setting: Each player can customize this for their own screen.
SETTINGSUI.GroupHpInBarDesc: Displays crisp, map-resolution-independent HP numbers, Temp HP overlays, and an Armor Class (AC) shield directly on token health bars.
SETTINGSUI.GroupBetterMeasureDesc: Keeps the distance measurement tool (Ruler & Token Drag Ruler) at a constant, readable size regardless of camera zoom level.
SETTINGSUI.GroupEasySendDesc: Lightweight player-to-player item and currency transfer via the inventory '...' menu, currency bar, or by dragging items onto another player's token.
SETTINGSUI.GroupSimpleLightDesc: Adds a customizable D&D 5e Light Sources picker to the left column of the Token HUD with timed Active Effects and per-player visibility.
SETTINGSUI.GroupEffectsManagerDesc: Adds a Token HUD button to toggle an actor's Active, Passive, and Disabled effects cleanly in one dialog.
SETTINGSUI.GroupStatusEffectsDesc: Expands the Token HUD conditions tray to show full status effect names beside every icon.
SETTINGSUI.GroupPauseBorderDesc: Highlights the paused game state with a glowing purple (or custom-colored) screen border and pause icon.
SETTINGSUI.GroupEasyFlipDesc: Horizontally mirrors selected tokens when pressing the flip keybinding (default: F in Configure Controls).
SETTINGSUI.GroupShowRangesDesc: Draws crisp 5 / 10 / 30 / 60 ft distance rings directly on tokens via the Show Ranges macro — privately for you by default or shared with everyone.
SETTINGSUI.GroupReadableDiceDesc: Keeps discarded and rerolled dice in expanded Advantage/Disadvantage chat roll tooltips clearly legible instead of overly faded.
READABLEDICE.EnableHint: Ensures discarded and rerolled dice numbers remain crisp and readable against the grey die icons in roll tooltips (especially in Dark Mode).
READABLEDICE.OpacityHint: Controls how prominent discarded/rerolled dice appear compared to the kept die (40% = strongly dimmed, 70% = balanced default, 100% = full opacity).
